create.name: Cheryl A. Page
create.bio:
Cheryl A. Page worked for more than twenty years in clinical research, much of it alongside hospice and palliative care, before the sudden death of her partner in 2017 turned her attention to communication with those in spirit. She now writes and teaches as a self-described modern mystic from Clifton in western Colorado, and she brings a researcher's habit of asking questions to a subject that is usually approached through belief alone.

At the centre of her teaching is an approach she calls VIBRATIONSHIP, which treats the bond with a loved one who has died as a relationship that can carry on and be looked after, with weight placed on discernment, clear intention and ethics rather than on proof. She teaches it in seven-week live courses run with Stevie Berkley's Life With Ghosts school, with earlier rounds kept as recordings, and she gives long readings over Zoom in which clients invite guides and figures from history as well as family. Her books Mystic Richness and The Fourth Thing explore AI language models as a tool for spiritual enquiry, and each month she hosts a free Zoom group on fresh ways of approaching contact across the veil.

courses.title: VIBRATIONSHIP 3.0: Living in Relationship with the Unseen
courses.description: A seven-week live online course, hosted by Stevie Berkley, that moves past looking for signs towards an ongoing relationship with loved ones in spirit and other unseen helpers. It works on steadiness, trust and discernment in that connection.
courses.price: $350 USD ($300 USD advance registration until 15 December)

courses.title: VIBRATIONSHIP 2.0: A New Paradigm of Spirit Communication
courses.description: The recorded second round of her seven-week course on spirit communication, sold on demand through the Life With Ghosts school. Her site says it stays available until spring 2027.

courses.title: VIBRATIONSHIP 1.0 On-Demand
courses.description: Ten recorded classes from the first live round of her course, bought one module at a time from her own shop. The homework sheets from the live course are not included.

courses.title: Quantum Reading
courses.description: A Zoom session of one and a half to two hours in which the client names up to eight people or beings in spirit, from family to historical figures, to ask for guidance. The emphasis is on insight and spiritual growth rather than evidence.

free_resources.title: What If? New Potentials in Cross-Veil Communication
free_resources.description: A free live Zoom group she leads on the first Tuesday of each month, exploring new approaches to mediumship. The link goes out in The Afterlife Report newsletter.

sprint.tier_evidence: YouTube @CherylPageMysticRichness 335 subscribers (channel header, 4 Nov 2026); Instagram, Facebook and Substack not read (no accounts linked from her site / Substack off limits) → ~335 total → local_hero
flags: No Shift mention on own site: listed without the link (mysticrichness.com home, about, courses, books, readings, videos, resources and vibrationship pages read 4 Nov 2026).
Regional: Clifton, Colorado (Grand Junction area, western Colorado), published in her site footer as 'Mystic Richness, Clifton Colorado, USA'.
Photos: both from her own site; the colour headshot looks polished and the black-and-white one older, so a human may want to confirm they are the same person (same glasses and hair, very likely).

Her VIBRATIONSHIP book is subtitled 'A New Paradigm of Grief'; it is about continuing bonds with the dead, not grief therapy, but I left it out anyway because no ISBN could be confirmed (see left_out).
Videos are mostly interviews on other channels where she is the main guest; some titles are sensational in the hosts' style (copied as they are). Her own channel has only two videos.
VIBRATIONSHIP 1.0 shop prices are rendered by script and could not be read, so 'Contact for pricing' is used.
She also sells oracle card decks (Quantum Professors, Quantum Visionaries) on her shop page; no ISBN, so not listed.
left_out: Books (Mystic Richness, The Fourth Thing, VIBRATIONSHIP: A New Paradigm of Grief, the illuminated edition of Maeterlinck's DEATH): her site links only a.co Amazon short links, which we may not open; one web search and the Barnes & Noble page gave no ISBN, and Open Library search is disallowed by robots.txt, so none could be confirmed.
Sensational interview titles (JeffMara 'ET Is Calling Me', Next Level Soul 'STORM Coming', Celestevolve channelling celebrities, Wisdom From North Tesla) left out as not evergreen teaching.
Two Life With Ghosts interviews linked from her site return 404 on oEmbed.
